mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inv_check_detail (check_id, material_id, batch_no, location_id, book_qty) SELECT #{checkId}, material_id, batch_no, location_id, qty FROM inv_stock WHERE warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, d.batch_no, d.location_id, l.code AS location_code, d.book_qty, d.actual_qty, d.diff_qty FROM inv_check_detail d LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = d.material_id LEFT JOIN base_location l ON l.id = d.location_id WHERE d.check_id = #{checkId} AND d.deleted = 0 ORDER BY d.id
